g.id: Latest filing (10-K or annual report), read whole in one long-context call
Model writes the memo in Damodaran's Stories to Numbers template
Librarian: retrieved Damodaran passages with citations
Dark Side passages for the company's uncertainty type (young, distressed, cyclical, financial, complex, emerging market)
Evidence list from licensed headlines and your own notes
Every claim classified: possible, plausible, probable (3P test)
Reverse DCF first: what does today's price require? implied revenue and market share
Proposed inputs as rows: growth y1 and y2 to 5, target margin and years, sales-to-capital, cost of capital path, failure probability, terminal assumptions; each with a claim id and a source locator
Guard rails: every claim cited? inputs inside Damodaran's plausibility bands?
You review the diff of proposed vs prior inputs in Cursor and approve or edit
Calculator runs (untouched engine); Monte Carlo range; sensitivity
valuation_run + memo version stored; realised prices scored at 90, 180 and 365 days
Opposing memo (mandatory second story, the Gurley field)
On re-run: classify the change as tweak, shift or break
